name: Burning Blood
description: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP.

name: Black Blood
description: Replaces Burning Blood. At the end of combat, heal 12 HP.

name: Red Skull
description: While your HP is at or below 50%, you have 3 additional Strength.

name: Champion Belt
description: Whenever you apply Vulnerable, also apply 1 Weak.

name: Charon's Ashes
description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.

name: Brimstone
description: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Strength and ALL enemies gain 1 Strength.

name: Runic Cube
description: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card.

name: Magic Flower
description: Healing is 50% more effective during combat.

name: Ring of the Snake
description: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.

name: Ring of the Serpent
description: Replaces Ring of the Snake. At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.

name: Snecko Skull
description: Whenever you apply Poison, apply 1 additional Poison.

name: Wrist Blade
description: Attacks that cost 0 deal 4 additional damage.

name: The Specimen
description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Poison it has to a random enemy.

name: Hovering Kite
description: The first time you discard a card each turn, gain 1 Energy.

name: Ninja Scroll
description: Start each combat with 3 Shivs in hand.

name: Paper Krane
description: Enemies with Weak deal 40% less damage instead of 25%.

name: Binding Talisman
description: Whenever an enemy dies, reap 1 Soul and gain 3 Block.

name: Tomb Dust
description: At combat start, channel 2 Souls into your spirit pool.

name: Soul Phylactery
description: Replaces Binding Talisman. Gain 1 Energy at start of turn. Whenever an enemy dies, reap 2 Souls.

name: Ossified Heart
description: When taking unblocked damage, consume 1 Soul to negate up to 10 damage.

name: Corpse Lantern
description: Whenever you summon a Minion or Totem, it gains 4 temporary Block.

name: Akabeko
description: Your first attack in each combat deals 8 additional damage.

name: Anchor
description: Start each combat with 10 Block.

name: Bag of Marbles
description: At the start of combat, apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

name: Blood Vial
description: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP.

name: Bronze Scales
description: Start each combat with 3 Thorns.

name: Lantern
description: Gain 1 Energy on the first turn of each combat.

name: Pen Nib
description: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.

name: Vajra
description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Strength.

name: Orichalcum
description: If you end your turn without Block, gain 6 Block.

name: Blue Candle
description: Curse cards can now be played. Playing a Curse card exhausts it and costs 1 HP.

name: Bottled Lightning
description: Upon pickup, choose a Skill card. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Bottled Tornado
description: Upon pickup, choose a Power card. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Meat on the Bone
description: If your HP is at or below 50% at the end of combat, heal 12 HP.

name: Paper Phrog
description: Enemies with Vulnerable take 75% more damage instead of 50%.

name: Shuriken
description: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Strength.

name: Kunai
description: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Dexterity.

name: Gremlin Horn
description: Whenever an enemy dies, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

name: Dead Branch
description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, add a random card to your hand.

name: Ice Cream
description: Energy is now conserved between turns.

name: Incense Burner
description: Every 6 turns, gain 1 Intangible.

name: Calipers
description: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block rather than all of your Block.

name: Tungsten Rod
description: Whenever you would lose HP, lose 1 less HP.

name: Unceasing Top
description: Whenever you have no cards in hand during your turn, draw a card.

name: Coffee Dripper
description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer Rest at Rest Sites.

name: Cursed Key
description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. Whenever you open a non-boss chest, obtain a Curse.

name: Fusion Hammer
description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites.

name: Pandora's Box
description: Upon pickup, transform all Strikes and Defends into random cards.

name: Runic Pyramid
description: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your hand.

name: Snecko Eye
description: Draw 2 additional cards each turn. Start each combat Confused (card costs randomized 0-3).

name: Velvet Choker
description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.

name: Orange Pellets
description: Whenever you play a Power, Attack, and Skill in the same turn, remove all your debuffs.

name: Membership Card
description: 50% discount on all purchases at the merchant.

name: The Courier
description: The merchant now restocks inventory. Merchant items cost 20% less.
